chrome-yellow.notes: Board hue at palette position 0; currently claimed by AI/. inkOn() gives it the dark ink. Light-mode solved leaf #f9e2b0 at alpha 0.700; dark-mode board #c08f24, leaf #241b07 at alpha 0.814.

teal.notes: Palette position 1; currently container/. Mid-luminance, so printable() pushes it to #168d83 in light mode before text goes on it. Light leaf #d5e9e5 at alpha 0.858; dark board #0f6f66, leaf #04201d.

ultramarine.notes: Palette position 2; currently script/. Takes the light ink. Light leaf #dee5f1 at alpha 0.888; dark board #1c4692, leaf #0b1b39.

grass.notes: Palette position 3, held in reserve. The next top-level folder lands here with no code change. printable() seats it at #518d3f in light mode.

sienna.notes: Palette position 6, held in reserve. hueFor() wraps past this index rather than falling back to grey.

binder-tan.notes: The board for the overview, which belongs to no category. Chromatic on purpose: a neutral grey mixed into the milk bleaches it instead of tinting it. Light leaf #eae4dc at alpha 0.879.

vermilion.notes: Held out of the board palette entirely. Destructive commands, errata, the sudo chip, the 404 panel. As ink on the leaf it is mixed by readableOn() to about #c22c19.

vermilion-dark.notes: A light salmon; text on it is the dark ink #16150F, because white on it is 2.8:1.

milk-light.notes: The acetate before compositing. The shipped reading field is this, carrying 0.14 of the board hue at the milk's own luminance, composited at the solved alpha. Target band: relative luminance 0.78.

milk-dark.notes: Dark-mode acetate. Target band: relative luminance 0.0115.

ink-light.notes: Light-mode primary ink. Secondary #57533F, tertiary #68634d. All three clear 4.5:1 on every solved light leaf (4.75-4.79:1 for the tertiary), asserted by scripts/check-contrast.mjs.

display.purpose: The README's own H1, the largest line on the site. Archivo at width 82, caps, balanced wrap.

headline.purpose: H2. Archivo at width 88, over a strong rule; the rule collapses when a markdown --- precedes it.

subtitle.purpose: H4-H6. Body size; family and weight carry the rank, not a second scale.

body.purpose: Every word meant to be read. One size for the whole site, 75ch measure, which lands Traditional Chinese at about 34 characters per line.

small.purpose: Index entries, TOC, provenance values, table body.

label.purpose: Chivo Mono caps. Only for things a machine said or measured: category names, byte counts, revision dates, language names, state.

code.purpose: The punched window's contents. Three inks only: what the machine runs, what it is told to run, and incidental syntax dropped back.

runtimeSolvedTokens.mechanism: site/src/design.ts solves the palette per route and per theme; site/src/components/AppShell.tsx publishes the result onto document.documentElement. These five values do not exist as CSS constants anywhere in the build; base.css holds first-paint fallbacks only.

properties.name: --board
properties.purpose: The section board at full strength: band, spine, tab rail, code-window head, selection background, caret.

properties.name: --leaf
properties.purpose: The composited reading field. Alpha is binary-searched over sRGB source-over until relative luminance lands in the mode's band (light 0.78, dark 0.0115).

properties.name: --leaf-alpha
properties.purpose: Published so the cut shadow can match the leaf it belongs to.

properties.name: --on-board
properties.purpose: Whichever of the two inks reads better printed on the board.

properties.name: --board-ink
properties.purpose: The board hue mixed toward the page's ink until it clears 4.5:1 as 13px text on the leaf.

properties.name: --danger-ink
properties.purpose: The same treatment for vermilion, which is a fill colour and unreadable as small text untreated.

properties.name: --age
properties.purpose: The ageing wash laid over the solved field: 0 fresh, 1 yellowing at 90 days, 2 bleached at 270.

contrastFloor.min: 4.5:1 for every pair asserted; no pair is held to the 3:1 large-text allowance
assertedPairs: primary / secondary / tertiary ink on the solved leaf, for all 7 board hues plus the binder hue, in both themes
inkOn()'s chosen ink on the board itself, at full strength
readableOn(board) used as ink on the leaf
readableOn(danger) used as ink on the leaf
the chosen ink on a vermilion fill (the sudo chip, the 404 panel), both themes
revisionOf() ageing steps at 10 / 89 / 90 / 269 / 270 days, and no revision line at all

shadows.name: cut-shadow
shadows.purpose: The leaf standing a millimetre off the board: one blurred fall, one 2px hard cut edge. Only on .leaf. Dark mode: 7px 0 16px -9px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), 2px 0 0 -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.6).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The open tab cut proud of the fore edge, and the mobile index drawer. Dark mode: 0 2px 12px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.8).

shadows.name: hole
shadows.purpose: The two punched binder holes on the spine.

motion.name: hinge
motion.purpose: The only motion value in the system. Every transition and the page-turn animation use it; nothing eases and nothing fades.

motion.name: leaf-turn
motion.value: from { transform: perspective(1400px) rotateY(-1.6deg) } to { transform: none }
motion.purpose: The signature: the leaf turning on its punched edge on every route change. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: no-smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Anchors land on their heading without scroll-behavior: smooth, which would be the one easing this world has.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: The object narrows but survives: spine 16px, rail 26px, band 60px, spine and tab labels hidden, index becomes a drawer.

breakpoints.name: prose-two-track
breakpoints.purpose: The prose grid drops to [margin] 132px [main] 1fr; the sheet loses its max-width and the measure is capped on the elements instead.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: WIDE in site/src/useMedia.ts. The page's own contents move into the fore-edge margin. Set here because the margin column costs about 210px, which is close to what a curl | sudo bash one-liner needs on one line.

texture.name: tooth
texture.value: an inline SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise tile, baseFrequency 0.9, 4 octaves, desaturated, opacity 0.09, 180x180
texture.blend: multiply in light, screen in dark
texture.purpose: Paper tooth and print ink. Every full-strength board surface and the leaf carry it; a gradient cannot be a texture.

narrative.overview:
這個世界是一本盒裝軟體的參考手冊：一塊印到滿版強度的分頁板（board），上面懸著一張薄薄一毫米的乳白賽璐珞內頁（leaf）。內頁是閱讀區，分頁板是分類。你不是在一份清單裡點選一個分類名稱，你是站在那個分類的顏色上。左緣有兩個裝訂孔與一條旋轉書背標，右側書口是一整排階梯式索引標籤，每個分類一片，高度按該分類的頁數分配，開啟中的那一片切出書口、變成當前的分頁板。

這個系統最不尋常的地方是：閱讀區的顏色在 CSS 裡根本不存在。--board、--leaf、--on-board、--board-ink、--danger-ink 由 site/src/design.ts 在執行期針對當前路由與主題解出，再寫上 <html>。內頁的 alpha 不是設計師挑的數字，而是對 sRGB source-over 合成做二分搜尋，直到合成後的閱讀區落進固定的相對亮度帶（light 0.78、dark 0.0115）。因此不論讀者站在鉻黃還是群青上，內文對比度都相同——對比是算出來的，不是看出來的，而且由 npm test 擋住。

材質是印刷品而非介面：分頁板與內頁都疊同一張程序生成的紙紋（--tooth，180×180 的 fractalNoise tile，light 用 multiply、dark 用 screen）。沒有卡片堆疊、沒有漸層裝飾、沒有毛玻璃、沒有圓角藥丸。整份文件是一張連續的內頁，層級靠髮絲線與留白，不靠陰影。
keyCharacteristics: 分頁板滿版上色，內頁半透明壓在上面；顏色由執行期解算，不由 CSS 常數決定。
分類色按照分類在 manifest 中的位置指派，永遠不按名稱；七色在冊，目前用三色。
朱紅（vermilion）被整個抽離出分類色盤，只花在危險上。
一種內文級數、75ch 行長；標題不長大，而是掛進外側的 margin 欄。
動態只有一種文法：90ms steps(2, end) 的兩格鉸鏈。沒有任何 easing、沒有任何 fade、也沒有 scroll-behavior: smooth。
狀態用記號表示，不用色相：勾、摺痕、打孔。
前端只持有 chrome；頁面內容一律是 README.md 的逐位元組渲染。

rules.name: The Solved Field Rule
rules.body: --board、--leaf、--on-board、--board-ink、--danger-ink 永遠不是 CSS 常數。它們由 AppShell.tsx 的 effect 逐路由、逐主題解出並寫上 document.documentElement，所有樣式表只能消費。想加一個顏色語意，加的是解算規則，不是色票。

rules.name: The Position-Not-Name Rule
rules.body: 分類色按 manifest 順序中的位置指派，永遠不按分類名稱。程式碼裡不存在 AI 這個字串對應鉻黃的地方。

rules.name: The Vermilion Reserve Rule
rules.body: 朱紅不進分類色盤。它只有一個意思：這會弄壞讀者的機器。任何把朱紅當強調色、當品牌色、當 hover 色的用法都破壞這條規則。

rules.name: The Computed Contrast Rule
rules.body: 對比下限由 npm test（site/scripts/check-contrast.mjs）強制，不靠自律。腳本對八塊板（七個分類色加裝訂褐）× 兩種主題逐一斷言：三級墨壓在解出的閱讀區上、inkOn() 選出的墨壓在滿版板上、readableOn() 混過的板色當墨、readableOn() 混過的朱紅當墨，全部 ≥ 4.5:1；再加上朱紅填色上的文字，以及 90/270 天的老化階梯。新增色相或重調亮度帶會在這裡失敗，而不是在讀者的螢幕上。

rules.name: The Ink-Is-Never-Hand-Tuned Rule
rules.body: 板色要當小字用，不是另外挑一個「文字版」色票，而是用 readableOn() 把同一個色相往頁面自己的墨色混，直到過 4.5:1；要印在滿版板上的字則用 inkOn() 從兩支墨裡挑贏的那一支。明年新增的分類自動被同一套搜尋涵蓋。

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: 標題的層級由 Archivo 的寬度軸承擔一部分：H1 wdth 82、H2 88、H3 92。寬度是這套顯示聲音的一部分，不是可有可無的裝飾；不要用預設寬度設標題。

rules.name: The One Body Size Rule
rules.body: 內文只有一個級數。密集的 README 靠字重、髮絲線與留白得到骨架，不靠第二套級距。行長寫成 75ch 而不是 62ch——ch 是拉丁 0 的寬度，繁體中文在 62ch 只有約 30 字，遠短於中文排版所需；75ch 讓拉丁落在上限、中文落在約 34 字，一個值同時成立。

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: 等寬字只給機器說過或量過的東西：指令、標籤、位元組數、修訂日期、狀態。它不是「技術感」的戲服；沒有機器在說話的地方就不要用它。

rules.name: The Hanging Head Rule
rules.body: H1–H3 橫跨 margin / wide 兩條軌道掛出文字欄之外，而不是靠放大來取得層級。

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: 散文永遠不超過 75ch；表格與指令視窗永遠可以吃掉整張紙。判準是「這段東西是拿來讀的，還是拿來檢查後複製的」。

rules.name: The Fore-Edge Rule
rules.body: 只有在 1600px 以上，本頁目錄才移進書口邊欄。任何時候都不能因此壓縮指令視窗的可視寬度。

rules.name: The Chrome-Only Rule
rules.body: 前端只擁有 chrome——產品名、標語、meta。頁面上所有散文都是 README.md 的逐位元組渲染，DESIGN.md 的任何規則都不得被理解成允許在 TSX 裡寫內容。

rules.name: The No-Stack Rule
rules.body: 一張連續的內頁，永遠不是一疊卡片。需要區隔就畫線或留白；需要強調就換墨色或字重。加一層陰影去分隔內容，等於承認這不是一本手冊。

rules.name: The Printed-Not-Filled Rule
rules.body: 分頁板與內頁都不是純色填滿，而是色 + --tooth 紙紋，以 multiply（light）／screen（dark）混合。新增任何滿版板色的表面都要帶上同一張紙紋，否則它會從物件上掉出來。

rules.name: The Two-Frame Hinge Rule
rules.body: 全站只有一種動態文法：--hinge: 90ms steps(2, end)。沒有任何 easing、沒有任何 fade、沒有 scroll-behavior: smooth。簽名動作是換頁時內頁沿打孔邊翻起的兩格鉸鏈，並在 prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 下完全關閉。

dos: Do 讓新的顏色語意經過 design.ts 的解算函式（solveLeaf()、readableOn()、inkOn()、printable()），而不是新增手調色票。
Do 為新增的分類只做一件事：新增一個頂層資料夾。色相、標籤、書口高度都會自己長出來。
Do 在改動色相、亮度帶或墨色之後跑 npm test；scripts/check-contrast.mjs 是這套系統唯一的對比裁判。
Do 用 --hinge 當所有過場的唯一值，並為每個動態補上 prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 的關閉分支。
Do 讓散文守住 75ch，讓表格與指令視窗跨 margin / -1 取整張紙寬。
Do 用記號（形狀）表達狀態，並在顏色之外另給一個字面載體。
Do 給任何滿版板色的新表面疊上 --tooth 紙紋與對應的 background-blend-mode。
Do 需要新圖示時照 20 框 / 1.5 線寬 / 無填色的規格手繪一支。
donts: Don't 在 CSS 裡硬寫 --board、--leaf、--on-board、--board-ink 或 --danger-ink 的值；base.css 那組僅是首次繪製前的回退。
Don't 把任何分類名稱綁到特定色相；指派永遠按位置。
Don't 把朱紅用在危險以外的任何地方——不當品牌色、不當強調色、不當 hover 色、不當第八個分類色。
Don't 加入 easing、fade、transition: all、scroll-behavior: smooth 或任何超過兩格的動畫。
Don't 用陰影或卡片堆疊來分隔內容；除了 --cut-shadow、--lift 與裝訂孔的內陰影之外，這個世界沒有第四支陰影。
Don't 加入漸層裝飾、毛玻璃、藥丸圓角或 --r（2px）以外的圓角——三個有物理理由的例外除外。
Don't 為標題引入第二套字級；層級由字重、Archivo 的寬度軸與掛出邊界承擔。
Don't 只用顏色表達狀態。
Don't 引入圖示字型、圖示套件，或拿 emoji 當介面圖示。
Don't 引入第四支字族，也不要讓 system-ui / Georgia 從回退位置升格成實際使用的顯示字體。
Don't 在 TSX 或 HTML 裡寫任何頁面散文；那是 README.md 的工作，這條是產品層級的硬約束。
